label: FIXTURE — SYNTHETIC. Invented for tests only. Not nutrition data, not fetched, not from the spec.
note: Every food description starts with "SYNTHETIC TEST FOOD (not nutrition data)" and every id is in the 9000000 range, which these fixtures reserve. Shapes follow the FDC detail/search field names; values are chosen to exercise one rule each. The two error bodies are modeled on the api.data.gov error format, which the genuine 429 in fetched-demo/r2 shares; they were not received from the API.
